mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_S_POSITION ( STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_CODE, MARKET_CODE, TOTAL_QTY, AVG_PRICE, CLOSE_FLAG, STATE_CODE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DATE, MODIFY_DATE ) VALUES ( #{stockGroup}, #{stockCode}, #{marketCode}, #{totalQty}, #{avgPrice}, NVL(#{closeFlag}, 'N'), NVL(#{stateCode}, 'HOLD'), #{createUser}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_S_POSITION SET TOTAL_QTY = #{totalQty}, AVG_PRICE = #{avgPrice}, MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE, STATE_CODE = NVL(#{stateCode}, STATE_CODE) WHERE POSITION_ID = #{positionId}
UPDATE TB_S_POSITION SET CLOSE_FLAG = 'Y', STATE_CODE = 'CLOSED', MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE POSITION_ID = #{positionId}

UPDATE TB_S_POSITION SET TOTAL_QTY = TOTAL_QTY + TO_NUMBER(#{addQty}), AVG_PRICE = ((TOTAL_QTY * AVG_PRICE) + (TO_NUMBER(#{addQty}) * TO_NUMBER(#{addPrice}))) / (TOTAL_QTY + TO_NUMBER(#{addQty})), MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE POSITION_ID = #{positionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_S_POSITION_TXN ( POSITION_ID, STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_CODE, ACTION_TYPE, QTY, PRICE, BEFORE_QTY, BEFORE_AVG, AFTER_QTY, AFTER_AVG, REASON_TEXT, JSON_PARAMS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{positionId}, #{stockGroup}, #{stockCode}, #{actionType}, NVL(#{qty},0), NVL(#{price},0), #{beforeQty}, #{beforeAvg}, #{afterQty}, #{afterAvg}, #{reasonText}, #{jsonParams}, #{createUser}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT TXN_ID, POSITION_ID, STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_CODE, ACTION_TYPE, QTY, PRICE, BEFORE_QTY, BEFORE_AVG, AFTER_QTY, AFTER_AVG, REASON_TEXT, JSON_PARAMS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DATE FROM TB_S_POSITION_TXN WHERE 1=1 AND POSITION_ID = #{positionId} AND STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_S_POSITION_EVENT ( POSITION_ID, STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_CODE, EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_LEVEL, EVENT_TIME, MESSAGE, JSON_PARAMS, SOURCE_TXN_ID, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{positionId}, #{stockGroup}, #{stockCode}, #{eventType}, NVL(#{eventLevel}, 'INFO'), NVL(#{eventTime}, SYSDATE), #{message}, #{jsonParams}, #{sourceTxnId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, POSITION_ID, STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_CODE, EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_LEVEL, EVENT_TIME, MESSAGE, JSON_PARAMS, SOURCE_TXN_ID, CREATE_DATE FROM TB_S_POSITION_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND POSITION_ID = #{positionId} AND STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} ORDER BY EVENT_TIME DESC
